import json
from pathlib import Path
for name in ('development-ablation-001','bounded-agent-comparison-001'):
 p=Path('docs/experiments/results')/name
 suite=json.loads((p/'frozen-suite.json').read_text()); score=json.loads((p/'comparison-score.json').read_text())
 print(name,'suite',suite['id'],'case author',suite['cases'][0]['author_record'],'score cases type',type(score['cases']).__name__,'case value',str(score['cases'])[:1400])
 for arm in ('A','B'):
  records=[json.loads(x.read_text()) for x in sorted(p.glob(f'*/{arm}/confirmation/confirmation-result.json'))]
  keys=['preparation_wall_s','execution_and_integrity_wall_s','final_evaluation_wall_s','phase_wall_s']
  print(arm,len(records), {k:sum(r[k] for r in records) for k in keys}, 'runs',sum(r['costs']['physical_rollouts'] for r in records),'nestedwall',sum(r['costs']['known_run_wall_s'] for r in records))
 print('score costs',score['arms']['A']['costs'])
p=Path('artifacts/development-ablation-001/D05-recurrent-carry/A/confirmation/execution')
b=json.loads((p/'bundle.json').read_text());run=b['runs'][1]
print('bundle keys',list(b));print('confirmation',str(b['confirmation'])[:1200]);print('run no trace',json.dumps({k:v for k,v in run.items() if k!='trace'})[:7800]);print('trace row',str(run['trace'][0])[:2400])
